data.narrative:
Herasight is a seed-stage biotech company that has raised $5M+, founded by Michael Christensen. Valuation analysis draws on a universe of 3 public comparables in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Of three triangulation methods examined, only Stage-Progression proved applicable. This approach uses the $5M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage progression in this sector, yielding an implied valuation of $12M. Peer-Median methodology could not be applied due to insufficient narrow-filter peers—while 7 same-sector comparables exist, none met the threshold of ≥3 datapoints within same or adjacent stage cohorts. Public-Comp Anchoring was inapplicable because the target's revenue is not disclosed; public biotech median P/S stands at 6.6x across the three tickers, but lacks an anchor point.

The single-method analysis supports a valuation range of $11M–$14M (median $12M), with meaningful uncertainty inherent in a single-method triangulation. Key risk factors include absence of stage-comparable private data, undisclosed revenue metrics that would enable public multiple anchoring, and the seed-stage volatility typical of pre-revenue or early clinical-stage biotech. A more robust assessment would require either peer financials or disclosure of Herasight's revenue run-rate.
